title: VibeShorts.AI
summary: An AI creative studio for short-form video that turns a plain-language brief into a cinematic 9:16 short with full creator control.
detail: Built for the Google Cloud AI Builder Cup (Media, Content & Digital Experiences track). A Gemini-powered Creative Director plans the storyboard and coordinates media generation across Gemini, Veo, and Lyria, with strict human-in-the-loop approval gates, upfront spend reservations, and rendering via HyperFrames and FFmpeg.

title: Autonomous Red Teaming Agent
summary: An agent that pentests other agents - hunting prompt injection, jailbreaks, and guardrail bypasses on a loop, then filing structured findings.
detail: Built for the KnowBe4 AI Hackathon as part of the winning team. The system acts as an autonomous red team: it plans attack campaigns, probes target agents with adaptive jailbreak strategies, scores guardrail failures, and reports reproducible traces. The same ideas later informed production agent-security work (prompt-injection classifiers, evaluation pipelines, Claude Agent SDK audits).

title: Matrix
summary: Data enhancement for training recommendations and phishing simulations - built for new users with no previously known profile or behavioral history.
detail: Matrix solves the cold-start problem in security awareness: it enriches sparse user data to power personalized training recommendations and realistic phishing simulations for brand-new users who have no prior history in the system.

title: AURATER - Trash-Eliminating Rover
summary: An autonomous unmanned rover that detects and collects trash - the project that started the applied-AI streak, published as primary author.
detail: Primary author of “AURATER: Autonomous Unmanned Rover with Advanced Trash Eliminating Robot,” presented at the International Conference on Recent Advances in Engineering and Technology. Computer vision plus mechatronics: detect debris, plan a path, pick it up. Best Paper at an IEEE-sponsored venue.

title: IllustratED
summary: History, science, and math for kids - explained with AI-generated illustrations so the idea lands as a picture, not a paragraph.
detail: An educational app for children focused on History, Science, and Math. Lessons are paired with on-the-fly illustrations (Gemini image models) so abstract ideas become visual stories. Built to make learning feel like opening a picture book that writes itself.

title: WhiZED · Socratic Tutor
summary: A Socratic tutor for school students that teaches in regional languages (Tamil & English) and asks before it answers - fine-tuned on Gemma 3n.
detail: WhiZED is a Socratic tutor for school students powered by fine-tuned Gemma 3n. Instead of dumping answers, it walks the student through questions, hints, and worked examples. Built for the Google Gemma 3n Hackathon on Kaggle.

title: Juno & Asimov
summary: Voice-first English practice for kids, including under-privileged learners, with GPT-backed conversation instead of flashcards.
detail: Juno is an AI spoken-English app aimed at kids, including under-privileged learners. Asimov is a GPT-powered English learning companion. Both experiments explore patient, voice-first practice loops rather than multiple-choice drills.
